DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Hip Dislocation (Right).

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision) combined with immediate onset of right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning is highly specific for a hip dislocation, often associated with a femoral head fracture. I need to confirm the exact position of the right leg (e.g., externally rotated and abducted) and request an X-ray to rule out associated fractures.
